assertion.rationale: F5: lint-ci's node job dies on its first step — a stale glob over .github/scripts/, deleted by the 2026-08-24 amendment, under set -euo pipefail with no nullglob — so npm test never runs across seven workspaces and the vuln-lab CVE-seed integrity check never executes. The JS/TS test gate is absent, not merely failing, and required checks being chosen 'after the first CI run' risks locking a permanently-red job out of the merge gauntlet forever. F6: the verifier's missing federated credential (3.12.1) means the per-layer verify jobs that are meant to provide ongoing control monitoring cannot authenticate at all, so continuous monitoring of security controls structurally does not happen despite G0 reporting green.

recommendation: Delete the dead node --check step outright rather than patching it with nullglob — a step that silently checks nothing is worse than a visibly failing one. Fix the verifier's federated credential per the 3.12.1 assessment and extend verify-g0.ps1 to assert real authentication succeeds, not just that the app registration exists.
